overall_assessment: No personal data or administrative dates are left in any of the 28 plans. Every 'Emneansvarlig/koordinator' and 'Faglærere' name (single, multiple and hyphenated) is removed with the Kontaktinformasjon block, and in all 3,791 NTNU offerings course_plan contains no 'Kontaktinformasjon', 'Emneansvarlig', e-mail, exam session, 'Undervisningsstart' or timetable; the remaining 'faglærer'/'koordinator' hits are prose. The 20 'removed' flags are false alarms for privacy: these are discontinued-course or thesis-shell pages where the exam-session tail is about half the text. They do expose one real defect: the greedy session cut also drops every assessment scheme after the first ('Vurderingsordning: Hjemmeeksamen og oppgave'). There is also a minor over-removal of rule dates in prose that leaves dangling text.

findings.evidence: Varighet 6 timer Vurderingsordning: Hjemmeeksamen og oppgave Ordinær eksamen - Høst 2017 Hjemmeeksamen Karakter Bokstavkarakterer Vekting 2/3
findings.description: The NTNU handler is documented to keep 'Vurderingsordning: …' and 'Karakter: …' and to drop only the exam sessions (R/anonymize.R comment, methods.qmd #307). When a page lists more than one assessment scheme, the raw text runs 'Vurderingsordning: Hjemmeeksamen' → sessions → 'Vurderingsordning: Hjemmeeksamen og oppgave' → sessions. The cut starts at the first 'Ordinær eksamen - Høst …' and runs to the end of the text, so it removes the second scheme's line and its components (Hjemmeeksamen 2/3 + Oppgave 1/3; Mappevurdering 2/3 + 1/3; 'Hjemmeeksamen og muntlig eksamen'). course_plan then ends with 'Vurderingsordning: Hjemmeeksamen' as if that were the only scheme. 18 of 28 packet courses are affected (all PPU 'del II' pages, ntnu_EXFAC0015-1_2009_summer_2, ntnu_PPU4789-1_2013_autumn_1 and the random control ntnu_PPU4773-1_2017_autumn_3). Across NTNU, 841 of 3,791 offerings have a 'Vurderingsordning:' line after the first session. The scheme names usually survive in the header line 'Vurderingsordning Hjemmeeksamen , Hjemmeeksamen og oppgave', which limits the damage. A related loss is already documented in methods.qmd #307 ('where the scale sits inside a session it is still lost'): in these same pre-2018 layouts 'Karakter Bokstavkarakterer' sits inside each session, so these plans also have no grading scale.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: R/anonymize.R .anon_ntnu(): stringr::str_remove("(?s)\\n(?:Ordinær|Utsatt|Ny|Kontinuasjons)\\s?eksamen - (?:Høst|Vår|Sommer).*$") is a single greedy cut from the first session to the end of the text, so any later 'Vurderingsordning:' line goes with it.
findings.suggested_fix: In .anon_ntnu(), remove each session block up to the next scheme instead of cutting to the end: str_remove_all("(?ms)^(?:Ordinær|Utsatt|Ny|Kontinuasjons)\\s?eksamen - (?:Høst|Vår|Sommer).*?(?=^Vurderingsordning: |^Alt om eksamen ved NTNU|^Timeplan$|\\z)"), keeping the existing 'Alt om eksamen ved NTNU' and Timeplan removals. Optionally, before cutting, turn the first in-session 'Karakter <scale>' into a 'Karakter: <scale>' line so pre-2018 plans keep their grading scale. Add a case with two 'Vurderingsordning:' lines to the NTNU test in tests/testthat/test-anonymize.R. Rebuild, explain the metrics_check change (and any plan_id splits, since the dedup hash already leaves the closing lines out), and update the #307 entry in methods.qmd.

findings.evidence: Alle masteroppgaver innlevert fra og med [−01.04.2014−] skal sensureres etter denne ordningen
findings.description: The generic dd.mm.yyyy rule removes the effective dates of assessment rules in running prose: the date the national sensur scheme for MNT master's theses took effect, and the date of the faculty's 'utfyllende regler for realfagsstudiene av [−01.08.2015−]'. These are not approval stamps or semester labels; they are regulation dates, which the rubric keeps. Removing them leaves sentences that now read wrongly: 'innlevert fra og med  skal sensureres' and 'realfagsstudiene av  for gjentak av masteroppgaven'. (The academic year 'For studieåret [−2017/2018−]' in the same BI3950-2 sentence is removed correctly.) Across NTNU, 60 offerings contain 'innlevert fra og med <date>' and 10 contain 'utfyllende regler … <date>'.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: R/anonymize.R .anon_generic(): the dd.mm.yyyy removal is exempted only by .not_gov, and .gov_doc_regex lists lov/forskrift/rammeplan/… but not institutional regulations ('regler', 'reglement') or a named scheme ('ordning'). In the KJ3950 text 'nasjonal ordning for sensur' also lies more than 80 characters before the date.
findings.suggested_fix: Add '(?:utfyllende )?regler|reglement' to .gov_doc_regex. That fixes 'utfyllende regler for realfagsstudiene av 01.08.2015', which is within 80 characters. For the sensur sentence, add a narrow exemption to the dd.mm.yyyy rule for 'innlevert fra og med <date>' (or accept the loss). Add both sentences to tests/testthat/test-anonymize.R.
